stage: scoring paradigm test (frozen-feature module search CLOSED)

frozen_inputs.feature_source: final-layer patch tokens (get_intermediate_layers n=1 norm=True), 448 input, 1024 patches/image
frozen_inputs.labels: official image_anomaly + raw boolean detectable filter (official_metrics from e11_p2_runner)

pca_definition.fit_on: raw (LayerNorm'd final-layer) mean-centered patch features, NO L2 normalization
pca_definition.covariance: empirical covariance over all bank patches (300*1024 = 307200 samples)
pca_definition.components_r: smallest r with cumulative explained variance >= tau
pca_definition.residual: S(x) = ||x - (mu + C C^T (x - mu))||_2^2  (squared reconstruction residual, SubspaceAD official)
pca_definition.note: sqrt vs squared is rank-equivalent; squared adopted per official

aggregations.AGG-1: MAX: image_score = max over 1024 patch residual scores
aggregations.AGG-2: SUBSPACE/TOP-REGION: image_score = mean of top k patch residual scores, k = max(1, ceil(0.01*1024)) = 11 (SubspaceAD TVaR top-1%)

matrix.note: S0 counted once per category and reused; 6 PCA cells computed per category

GO: mean dAUROC >= +0.010 AND mean dAP >= 0 AND no category dAUROC < -0.020
OR 3/3 categories dAUROC > 0 AND mean dAUROC >= +0.007 AND mean dAP >= 0
decision_rules.HOLD: 2/3 categories positive AND mean dAUROC > 0 AND AP not clearly down (esp. ~+0.005..+0.010)
STOP: OR only 1/3 categories positive with tiny gain
OR catastrophic drop in some category
OR all improvements at noise level

not_allowed: tune until a category looks good
